aconteció: it came to pass; it happened
alumbre: let it shine; may give light
andad: walk, go (to several people; old form)
ben: Ben (name); part of the name Ben-hadad
beth: Beth (Hebrew letter; part of place names)
consigo: with him; with them; with himself
conviene: it is fitting; it is necessary
decid: say, tell (to several people; old form)
echar: to throw, cast; to drive out
echaron: they threw, cast; they drove out
ejidos: suburbs; pasture lands of a city
estad: be, stand (to several people; old form)
fueren: (if they) should be; should go (old form)
haced: do; make (to several people; old form)
harás: you will do; you shall make
haré: I will do; I will make
levantar: to raise, lift up; to rise
levantarán: they will raise; they will rise
pondrás: you will put; you shall set
pondré: I will put; I will set
poned: put, set (to several people; old form)
ruego: I pray; I beg; a plea
ruégote: I pray you; I beg you (old form)
saldrá: (he) will go out; will come out
salir: to go out; to come out
salían: they went out, were going out
tomarás: you will take; you shall take
tornaré: I will return; I will turn (old form)
visitaré: I will visit; I will punish
